lossless_expansion.formula: K=2^(74(h+1)); P=2^(64(h+1)); S_i=Σ_(j=0)^(h−i)K^j. For 0≤i≤h and even 4≤p≤P, a coordinate c assigns a Fin n label to each of the p S_i ordered slots (r,j,k), 0≤r<p, 0≤j≤h−i, 0≤k<K^j. The Σ b, C b tags each of the n^(p S_i) entries by its block; group(ξ)_b(c)=ξ_(b,c). No rescaling, quotient or loss of order.

For γ=N(0,1), the flat Euclidean standard Gaussian is the Euclidean realization of ⊗_(b,c) γ. Currying sends that scalar product to ⊗_b(⊗_(c∈C_b) γ) by mere coordinate regrouping. The source independent block law supplies the product in the opposite orientation, not a Lean premise.
